goal: Fixes fatal node crashes on pruned nodes using assumeutxo with secondary indexes enabled
Ensures indexes save progress on early flush notifications so required blocks are not pruned before commit
agreement: Approach objection: keeping or widening the locator check blocks safe commits (fjahr)
Author agreed to adopt alternative commits that remove the check and rely on Commit() (fjahr)

categories.name: indexes
why: P1 because it prevents fatal node crashes on pruned nodes with secondary indexes enabled during assumeutxo
Fixes an issue where index progress lag allowed blocks to be pruned before the index could commit them
